name: rank_regions
description: Rank administrative regions by a climate, hazard, exposure, vulnerability, or risk value. Usually used after aggregate_by_admin_region.

input_artifact.description: Required region-level spatial artifact containing GeoJSON features and a numeric value column to rank.

value_column.description: Numeric column used for ranking. If omitted, the function uses the value_column metadata from the input artifact.

region_name_column.description: Optional column containing region names. If omitted, the function tries common names like admin_name, region_name, name, district, province, island, or municipality.

region_id_column.description: Optional column containing stable region IDs. If omitted, the function tries common names like admin_id, region_id, id, gid, adm_id, or iso_code.

direction.description: Whether higher or lower values should rank first. Supported examples: highest, lowest, top, bottom, max, min, worst, best.

top_n.description: Number of ranked regions to return when include_all_regions is false. If null, all valid regions are returned.

include_all_regions.description: If true, return all valid regions ranked, ignoring top_n filtering.

include_missing_regions.description: If true, include regions with missing or non-numeric values as unranked rows.

return_geometry_format.description: Geometry output format. Currently only GeoJSON is supported.

input_artifact_type.description: Artifact type of the input region layer.

input_layer_id.description: Layer ID of the input artifact, if available.

layer_id.description: Generated layer ID for the ranked-region output.

variable.description: Climate, hazard, exposure, vulnerability, or risk variable ranked.

source_variable.description: Original source variable, if different from the derived variable.

admin_level.description: Admin level inherited from the input artifact, if available.

source_value_column.description: Original numeric column used for ranking.

rank_percentile_column.description: Column containing rank percentile values. Usually 'rank_percentile'.

direction.description: Normalized rank direction: highest or lowest.

top_n.description: Number of ranked regions returned when top_n filtering is used.

geojson.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection containing ranked region features.

input_feature_count.description: Number of input region features before ranking.

valid_count.description: Number of regions with valid numeric values.

missing_count.description: Number of regions with missing or non-numeric values.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minx, miny, maxx, maxy].

summary.description: Summary information about ranking input/output values.

table.description: Table-friendly ranked output with rank, region name, value, rank score, percentile, and category.

provenance.description: Information about ranking method and parent artifact.
